notes.title: Her Love, Like Poison has been released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I'm just making a quick post to let you know that my spooky yuri visual novel, Her Love, Like Poison, has been released!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/468de97559b15a5487765facaaccdfa38150a8b6.png

If you've read any of my other yuri VNs, then Her Love, Like Poison might look familiar. The character art is by the same artist of my previously released yandere yuri visual novel, It gets so lonely here, and the UI is in a similar style.

I wrote Her Love, Like Poison pretty soon after finishing up Lonely (I must have been in the mood for more toxic yuri set in the woods), so while the two stories are unrelated, they might be a little bit similar tone-wise.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/46466091d3d03b8df4af805527fbf3963269452b.png

In any case, I hope you enjoy the story if you do check it out! It's quite a short game, so it's priced accordingly (it's $6.99 with a 10% launch discount).

You can pick it up here if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412620/

As always, thank you for your support over the years! It's very much appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: Cage of Roses has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that my newest VN, Cage of Roses, has finally been released!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/341617e79554b0ba094ae0721a5f69a1dae11db3.png

I say 'finally' because I wrote the script for this VN all the way back in early 2021. It took about 4 years for me to get this project pieced together, but I'm very glad that I stuck with it until the bitter end!

I think the art by Rock CR and the music by Sarah Mancuso is especially lovely, and it really adds to the overall atmosphere of the story. They really went all-in on the pretty visuals and the ominous, eerie music, and I think it all comes together really nicely!

It's been a dream of mine to write a spooky vampire story for over a decade, and I'm very happy I was finally able to do that. I hope I did the idea justice!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e1337ddc7798b6b2474b10fa665becf331e0c2dd.png

You can check out the VN here if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2993720

Please let me know if you run into any bugs or typos, and I'll do my best to fix them within a reasonable timeframe.

Thank you, as always, for your support over the years. It's very much appreciated, and I hope you'll all enjoy my newest yuri story!

- ebi x

notes.title: Announcing a few new yuri VNs
notes.content:
Hi everyone! \o/

I'm just making a quick announcement to let you know I'm working on a couple of shiny new yuri VNs (when am I ever not working on yuri VNs tbh haha...)

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/9a51e465b0860b14817b915b9055718aada6b25d.png

The first on the list is Her Love, Like Poison! It's a dour little VN set in the English countryside during the winter, so it'll be very bleak and cold and miserable!

It's a story about a university student, Ethel, who's struggling to muster up the enthusiasm to work on her thesis while girlrotting in her parents' home in a teeny-tiny village.

Stuck for inspiration, she goes for a wander in the woods late at night, and has an encounter with a mysterious girl who might be more than she seems.

This is a spooky VN with some sexual themes and body horror elements. It goes some rather dark places, but I don't think it's too unpleasantly awful. The character art was also done by the artist of It gets so lonely here!

You can wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412620

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/21c7a110772231d437f9e96fbd777c3035db5f1d.png

And the second on the list is Bittersweet Blossoms. It's a historical yuri VN that takes place in England in 1919, a little after WWI.

Follow Dot, a young girl who lost both her father and her older brother in the war, as she starts working in the stately home of Bly as a maid. At Bly, Dot meets her sadistic young mistress, Patience, and the two begin an uneasy relationship.

This VN is a sequel of sorts to Blackberry Honey, though it takes place about 60 years after the events of BH. It might be an interesting read if you want to see what became of Bly over the years!

You can wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429340/Bittersweet_Blossoms/


And that's about eveything. Please look forward to these VNs; I'll try to release them both later this year!

- ebi x

notes.title: My Lovey-Dovey Demon has been released! 💗
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I'm writing a quick devlog to let you know that my most recent visual novel, My Lovey-Dovey Demon, has been released! Yay \o/

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e869aec72dd4182535668ade5c2d4530d9819120.jpg

You can check the VN out here, if you're interested:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183430

MLDD is a VN that's been in process for quite a while. I wrote the script back in 2021, and it took me a while to piece the whole story together. The Steam store page was up for over a year before I finally released it, so some people have been waiting on this one for a while haha

It might have taken me some time to finish this project, but I tried to use this time to ensure that it's as polished as possible! The main artist, Kimoreen, did a great job with the character artwork, and all of the cute chibi cut-ins by Konayachi are adorable!

I also had some help from Harmonie of Asminae Games, who created Reborn a Zombie (available for free on Steam), to do some work on the various visual effects in this VN. That means this VN has some fun effects during the CGs which I've not added to any of my previous projects such as light rays, animated particles, and moving fog. I think it helps the VN pop, and it brings the story to life!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/76da6cae1c84a845dd2d5c2968af720c4f21c4b5.png

Speaking of the story, it's a pretty cute, light affair which takes a lot of cues from typical BxG slice of life VNs. It's quite chill and relaxed, and there isn't much in the way of conflict (which might be a bit of a rarity coming from me lol), so this should be a good read if you're looking for something cosy. It's pretty similar to The Language of Love in that it's a wholesome BxG romance story, though it has a bit more of a comedy focus like My Dear Prince.

Everybody put a lot of effort into this VN, so I hope you all enjoy it! ♡

As always, let me know if you find any typos or bugs in the VN, and I'll try to fix them up within a reasonable timeframe!

- ebi x

notes.title: My Lovey-Dovey Demon will be released soon! 💗
notes.content:
Hello everybody! It's ebi \o/

I'm just writing a quick announcement to let you all know that I'll be releasing my cute romance VN, My Lovey-Dovey Demon, on Steam in a few weeks!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/ebfc1ba0d6bbfeeac56eb9873a95de91d09be247.jpg

My Lovey-Dovey Demon is a cute story set in modern day Japan with a young male protagonist, Taiki. Taiki is spending the summer vacation at his grandparents' home in the countryside alongside his younger siblings.

During his vacation Taiki's sister, the naughty Nene, sneaks into their grandfather's study and starts rifling through his books about the occult. Taiki tries to stop her, and in the chaos, he inadvertently ends up summoning a demon from another realm.

This demon has horns, wings, and a tail, dresses in black, sharp teeth...

And she also happens to be utterly adorable!

This demon, Elisabeth, is immediately attracted to Taiki. Now, he's stuck being buddy-buddy with a cute demon girl, when all he wanted was a bit of rest and relaxation. What's a guy to do?!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/9f2e5679384251f1959cca626c5e79a6595be807.png

My Lovey-Dovey Demon is a romance VN with a male protagonist, which feels pretty rare coming from me. I think the last time I wrote a cute BxG romance story was The Language of Love, so I hope people who liked LoL will be similarly charmed by this story!

The premise of My Lovey-Dovey Demon pretty goofy and it doesn't take itself too seriously. Tonally, it's pretty similar to My Dear Prince or Strawberry Vinegar, so anybody who enjoyed those stories might like this.

The VN is more or less completed, and its build has been approved by Steam. I'm still waiting on a few more assets, but I should be able to release it in early January.

I hope you'll enjoy My Lovey-Dovey Demon when it comes out! If you want tbe notified when it releases, you can either follow my Steam developer page or wishlist the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183430

- ebi x

notes.title: BL VN In Fair Spirits has been released 💚✨
notes.content:
Hello everybody! \o/

I'm writing this announcement to let you know that I've released a new VN on Steam (though you might have seen it already if you follow my developer page haha), In Fair Spirits!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/b4bca2b31616e8d7b7e6fb1f21e6869ecc86b5b9.png


In Fair Spirits ​is a sweet and wholesome slice of life story which details the slowly developing relationship between Edmund, a knight from medieval England who finds himself reincarnated into the 21st century for... reasons, and Abel, a peppy goth boy who speaks in incomprehensible internet slang that Edmund can't understand.

(Yes, Abel is a Tumblr user. Yes, his dialogue is peppered with various dated Tumblr memes/references from 2013/14. No, I will not apologise for this... Though maybe Abel should lol...)

Edmund and Abel might seem like polar opposites but they soon discover they have a few things in common (spoilers: it's trauma). They wind up bonding, and then...

Well, this is a romance story, so things inevitably go in a lovey-dovey direction! 💚

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e420174b76ed8a9ee0e0e3e5d9ec548c8ce0ab6a.png


In Fair Spirits is actually the third in a series, the first being ​The Fairy's Song ​and the second being ​The Fairy's Secret​. ​In Fair Spirits ​is a direct sequel to ​The Fairy's Secret​, and it takes place around a year after the events of that story. You don't need to have read ​Fairy's Song ​or ​Fairy's Secret ​to grasp what happens here, though, so if you just want BL fluff you can jump straight into this story without any problems.

Alternatively, if you're only interested in cute yuri fluff (The Fairy's Song and Secret are both yuri VNs), then you should probably give In Fair Spirits a miss. Marnie and Lisbeth, the lead couple from Song/Secret, do appear here, but their appearances are more like cameos, and they don't have much screentime.

If this story sounds like your cup of tea, then you can check it out here! 💚

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2622770

As always, thank you for all of your support! Since I write a lot of different stoires in different genres, I know they won't always appeal to everybody, but I hope at least some people have fun with this!

- ebi x

notes.title: BL VN In Fair Spirits has been announced ✨
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

It's been over a week since I released my latest yuri VN, Fragile Feelings, which has been performing well! Thank you very much for the support; it's very much appreciated!

By the way you can check out Fragile Feelings here if you're interested...
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025700

So! Why am I writing this post?

Well, since I've just released a project which was in WIP hell for a while, I thought I might as well make a shiny new announcement! \o/

I've been working on a spin-off/sequel to The Fairy's Secret called In Fair Spirits! I've actually been working on In Fair Spirits for a while. I started writing the script for it before I'd released The Fairy's Secret, and a large chunk of the project has been finished, though I've not spoken about very much.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/d92de4f08cc0c7f6d124a7ddd76302badc0ccf92.png

In Fair Spirits is a BL VN which features Edmund as the main character. Edmund was a fairly underutilised and one-dimensional antagonist in The Fairy's Song, though I fleshed him out a bit and upgraded him to a semi-important side character in The Fairy's Secret.

I enjoyed writing Edmund quite a bit, however, and I felt like there was still room to develop and expand upon him. I wanted to give her character arc a bit of closure...

So, In Fair Spirits was born.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/64b425a0f62b415dfce8615412a9f3b6e7a005f2.png

In Fair Spirits is set one year after the events of The Fairy's Secret. It deals with Edmund trying to adapt and adjust to life in the 21st century, and how to navigate his complicated feelings about leaving his old way of life (and his beloved younger sister) behind him. He also meets a cute gothic boy living in Fenchapel, one thing leads to another, and they end up kissing.

If this sounds like it would be your thing, you can check out the Steam store page for In Fair Spirits here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2622770

Do consider dropping it a wishlist if you want to check it out! 🙏

And as an aside: Marnie and Lisbeth do show up in this VN, but they're cameo characters. They don't play a large role in the story, so if you're only interested in cute yuri, then you might want to give this a miss.

- ebi x

notes.title: Yuri VN The Fairy's Secret released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone! \o/

I’m writing this announcement to let you know that I've recently released a sequel to my cute yuri VN The Fairy’s Song called The Fairy’s Secret! The Fairy’s Secret is a linear visual novel set in modern day England which centres around the relationship between a grumpy goth and her medieval knight girlfriend. 

The story is of a similar length to the original Fairy’s Song and it has a similar tone. It’s quite a light-hearted story, for the most part, though there are some fantasy elements and a few moments of intrigue and mystery. The VN is available in both English and Simplified Chinese, and a German translation might happen in the future if the sales are strong enough to support it.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024327/2d2be389c8805ea7eae85f289589a7ba49a68bfe.png

If you enjoyed The Fairy’s Song and wanted to read more about Marnie’s adventures, then you should enjoy The Fairy’s Secret!

You can buy it on Steam here, if you’re interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1994760/The_Fairys_Secret

And I’ve also put The Fairy’s Song  on sale on Steam to celebrate the occasion, along with a few of my other cute yuri VNs. You can check out my bundle of yuri VNs here:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26031/EbiHime_Yuri_Bundle/

Alternatively,, you can buy The Fairy’s Song and The Fairy’s Secret bundled together for an even deeper discount than you’d get buying them individually here:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30485/The_Fairys_Bundle/

I hope you’ll enjoy reading more about Marnie’s time in Fenchapel with her cute knight girlfriend!

- ebi x
